new_works.title: Intent at a Glance: Gaze-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Foundation Models
new_works.why: 探索注视作为意图输入的基础模型驱动交互范式，拓展人机协作交互方式
new_works.attention: 中：注视交互在辅助机器人有独特优势，结合基础模型是新尝试
new_works.recommendation: ★★☆☆☆：交互创新但系统完整性与鲁棒性待验证，优先级较低

new_works.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion
new_works.why: Systematically analyzes four fundamental sources of sim-to-real gap (dynamics, contact, state estimation, solvers) relevant to both locomotion and manipulation contact-rich tasks.
new_works.attention: 中 - Comprehensive gap taxonomy; preprint status limits authority
new_works.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ - Valuable gap analysis but not yet peer-reviewed; cross-domain relevance

new_works.title: KDPE: A Kernel Density Estimation Strategy for Diffusion Policy Trajectory Selection
new_works.why: 针对 Diffusion Policy 部署时的随机性与异常值敏感问题，给出轻量级后处理选择策略，工程落地成本低
new_works.attention: 中：扩散策略是当前主流模仿学习范式，其可靠性改进需求大
new_works.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：实用的工程改进，适合作为 Diffusion Policy 部署的基线组件

new_works.title: ActivePose: Active 6D Object Pose Estimation and Tracking for Robotic Manipulation
new_works.why: 提出 VLM 驱动的主动位姿估计范式，动态解决视角歧义与遮挡，工程上可直接集成到抓取/操作流水线
new_works.attention: 中：主动感知+VLM 是具身感知新趋势，真机部署潜力大
new_works.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：方法清晰且面向真机痛点，但需等待开源与第三方验证

new_findings.key: gem-4d-提出了一种几何增强的视频世界模型通过注入来自预训练几何基础模型的稠密-4d-对应监督解决了视频世界模型在时间上难以一致追踪同一物理点的问题从而为机器人操作提供物理-grounding
new_findings.text: GEM-4D 提出了一种几何增强的视频世界模型，通过注入来自预训练几何基础模型的稠密 4D 对应监督，解决了视频世界模型在时间上难以一致追踪同一物理点的问题，从而为机器人操作提供物理 grounding。
new_findings.evidence: 论文指出视频世界模型虽能生成逼真未来帧，但常无法在时间上一致追踪同一物理点，导致缺乏可靠动作执行所需的物理 grounding。GEM-4D 在训练阶段将预训练几何基础模型蒸馏的稠密 4D 对应监督注入视频生成主干，实现外观与几何结构的联合建模，且保持单流架构、无额外推理开销。

new_findings.key: 视频世界模型在机器人操作中的关键瓶颈是时序几何一致性缺失而非生成质量
new_findings.text: 视频世界模型在机器人操作中的关键瓶颈是时序几何一致性缺失，而非生成质量。
new_findings.evidence: 论文明确指出：视频世界模型生成的视频看似合理，却因无法在时间上一致追踪同一物理点，而缺乏机器人操作所需的物理 grounding。

new_findings.key: gem-4d-提出几何增强的视频世界模型解决视频生成中物理点跨时刻一致性缺失问题为机器人操作提供物理-grounding
new_findings.text: GEM-4D 提出几何增强的视频世界模型，解决视频生成中物理点跨时刻一致性缺失问题，为机器人操作提供物理 grounding
new_findings.evidence: GEM-4D 通过几何 grounding 使生成视频在时间维度保持同一物理点一致性，解决现有视频世界模型生成视频看似合理但缺乏物理 grounding、难以用于可靠动作执行的问题

new_findings.key: activepose-结合-vlm-与机器人想象实现主动-6d-位姿估计与跟踪动态消除视角歧义
new_findings.text: ActivePose 结合 VLM 与「机器人想象」实现主动 6D 位姿估计与跟踪，动态消除视角歧义
new_findings.evidence: 离线阶段渲染 CAD 模型密集视图并计算 FoundationPose 熵构建几何感知提示；运行时查询 VLM 实时检测并消除歧义，解决零样本方法在视角诱导歧义与固定相机遮挡下的失效

new_findings.key: kdpe-利用核密度估计对-diffusion-policy-生成轨迹进行选择缓解扩散随机性与异常值学习导致的分布外问题
new_findings.text: KDPE 利用核密度估计对 Diffusion Policy 生成轨迹进行选择，缓解扩散随机性与异常值学习导致的分布外问题
new_findings.evidence: 针对 Diffusion Policy 两大缺陷：去噪随机性影响轨迹质量、监督学习易学到数据异常值；KDPE 通过核密度估计评估轨迹似然并选择高密度轨迹

new_findings.key: gamma-系统利用注视引导的基础模型实现模块化自主操作提供直观人机交互接口
new_findings.text: GAMMA 系统利用注视引导的基础模型实现模块化自主操作，提供直观人机交互接口
new_findings.evidence: 眼动作为快速、非侵入、意图丰富的输入模态；GAMMA 利用基础模型将注视转化为操作意图，面向辅助照护场景

new_findings.text: Sim-to-real transfer remains a fundamental bottleneck for generalist robot manipulation policies, with evaluation benchmarks lagging behind simulation advances.
new_findings.evidence: Current vision-based robotics simulation benchmarks have advanced manipulation research, but real-world evaluation for generalist policies has lagged. The paper proposes three desiderata: high visual-fidelity simulation, systematic task complexity/perturbation evaluation, and quantifying sim-real performance alignment.

new_findings.text: Primary sources of sim-to-real gap in deep RL for legged locomotion are identified as robot dynamics, contact modeling, state estimation, and numerical solvers.
new_findings.evidence: The chapter dissects the 'curse of simulation' by analyzing four primary sources of sim-to-real gap: robot dynamics, contact modeling, state estimation, and numerical solvers.

new_findings.text: There is a critical need for benchmarks that evaluate policy robustness through systematic task complexity increases and scenario perturbations, not just nominal performance.
new_findings.evidence: Paper proposes evaluating policies by systematically increasing task complexity and scenario perturbation to assess robustness, moving beyond static benchmark evaluations.

new_findings.text: Quantifying performance alignment between simulation and real-world deployment is an unresolved challenge for generalist policy evaluation.
new_findings.evidence: The paper identifies quantifying performance alignment between real-world performance and its simulation counterparts as a key desideratum for benchmark design.
